arguments: p_show_id uuid, p_breed_name text, p_scope text, p_show_letter text
definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.report_results_awards_for_breed_detail(p_show_id uuid, p_breed_name text, p_scope text, p_show_letter text)
 RETURNS TABLE(entry_id uuid, award_code text, exhibitor_label text, breed_name text, variety_name text, group_name text, class_name text, sex text, tattoo text, animal_label text)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
AS $function$
with filtered_sections as (
  select s.id
  from public.show_sections s
  where s.show_id = p_show_id
    and upper(coalesce(s.kind::text, '')) = upper(coalesce(p_scope, ''))
    and (
      upper(coalesce(p_show_letter, '')) = 'ALL'
      or upper(coalesce(s.letter::text, '')) = upper(coalesce(p_show_letter, ''))
    )
    and s.is_enabled = true
),

all_detail_rows as (
  select
    rer.entry_id,
    rer.exhibitor_label,
    rer.breed_name,
    rer.variety_name,
    rer.group_name,
    rer.class_name,
    rer.sex,
    rer.tattoo,
    coalesce(rer.tattoo, '') as animal_label
  from filtered_sections fs
  cross join lateral public.report_results_entry_rows(
    p_show_id,
    fs.id,
    p_show_letter
  ) rer
),

breed_detail_rows as (
  select *
  from all_detail_rows adr
  where lower(btrim(coalesce(adr.breed_name, ''))) =
        lower(btrim(coalesce(p_breed_name, '')))
),

raw_awards as (
  select
    ea.entry_id,
    ea.award_code::text as raw_award_code
  from public.entry_awards ea
  where ea.show_id = p_show_id
    and ea.award_code is not null
    and btrim(ea.award_code) <> ''

  union

  select
    r.entry_id,
    r.award::text as raw_award_code
  from public.results r
  where r.show_id = p_show_id
    and r.award is not null
    and btrim(r.award) <> ''
),

award_union as (
  select
    ra.entry_id,
    case upper(btrim(ra.raw_award_code))
      when 'BEST IN SHOW' then 'BIS'
      when 'BIS' then 'BIS'

      when 'RESERVE IN SHOW' then 'RIS'
      when 'RESERVE BEST IN SHOW' then 'RIS'
      when 'RESERVE OF SHOW' then 'RIS'
      when 'RESERVE IN SHOW - RIS' then 'RIS'
      when 'RIS' then 'RIS'
      when 'RBIS' then 'RIS'

      when 'BEST 4 CLASS' then 'B4C'
      when 'BEST 4-CLASS' then 'B4C'
      when 'BEST FOUR CLASS' then 'B4C'
      when 'B4C' then 'B4C'

      when 'BEST 6 CLASS' then 'B6C'
      when 'BEST 6-CLASS' then 'B6C'
      when 'BEST SIX CLASS' then 'B6C'
      when 'B6C' then 'B6C'

      when 'HONORABLE MENTION' then 'HM'
      when 'HM' then 'HM'

      when 'BEST OF BREED' then 'BOB'
      when 'BOB' then 'BOB'

      when 'BEST OPPOSITE SEX OF BREED' then 'BOSB'
      when 'BEST OPPOSITE OF BREED' then 'BOSB'
      when 'BOS' then 'BOSB'
      when 'BOSB' then 'BOSB'

      when 'BEST OF GROUP' then 'BOG'
      when 'BOG' then 'BOG'

      when 'BEST OPPOSITE SEX OF GROUP' then 'BOSG'
      when 'BEST OPPOSITE OF GROUP' then 'BOSG'
      when 'BOSG' then 'BOSG'

      when 'BEST OF VARIETY' then 'BOV'
      when 'BOV' then 'BOV'

      when 'BEST OPPOSITE SEX OF VARIETY' then 'BOSV'
      when 'BEST OPPOSITE OF VARIETY' then 'BOSV'
      when 'BOSV' then 'BOSV'

      else upper(btrim(ra.raw_award_code))
    end as award_code
  from raw_awards ra
),

overall_awards as (
  select
    adr.entry_id,
    au.award_code,
    adr.exhibitor_label,
    adr.breed_name,
    adr.variety_name,
    adr.group_name,
    adr.class_name,
    adr.sex,
    adr.tattoo,
    adr.animal_label
  from all_detail_rows adr
  join award_union au
    on au.entry_id = adr.entry_id
  where au.award_code in (
    'BIS',
    'RIS',
    'B4C',
    'B6C',
    'HM'
  )
),

breed_awards as (
  select
    bdr.entry_id,
    au.award_code,
    bdr.exhibitor_label,
    bdr.breed_name,
    bdr.variety_name,
    bdr.group_name,
    bdr.class_name,
    bdr.sex,
    bdr.tattoo,
    bdr.animal_label
  from breed_detail_rows bdr
  join award_union au
    on au.entry_id = bdr.entry_id
  where au.award_code in (
    'BOB',
    'BOSB',
    'BOG',
    'BOSG',
    'BOV',
    'BOSV'
  )
)

select
  x.entry_id,
  x.award_code,
  x.exhibitor_label,
  x.breed_name,
  x.variety_name,
  x.group_name,
  x.class_name,
  x.sex,
  x.tattoo,
  x.animal_label
from (
  select * from overall_awards
  union all
  select * from breed_awards
) x
order by
  case x.award_code
    when 'BIS' then 1
    when 'RIS' then 2
    when 'B4C' then 3
    when 'B6C' then 4
    when 'HM' then 5
    when 'BOB' then 6
    when 'BOSB' then 7
    when 'BOG' then 8
    when 'BOSG' then 9
    when 'BOV' then 10
    when 'BOSV' then 11
    else 99
  end,
  x.breed_name,
  x.variety_name,
  x.sex,
  x.class_name,
  x.exhibitor_label;
$function$

arguments: p_show_id uuid, p_breed_name text, p_scope text, p_show_letter text
definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.report_results_entry_rows_for_breed_detail(p_show_id uuid, p_breed_name text, p_scope text, p_show_letter text)
 RETURNS TABLE(entry_id uuid, show_id uuid, section_id uuid, section_label text, section_kind text, section_letter text, exhibitor_id uuid, exhibitor_label text, breed_name text, variety_name text, group_name text, sex text, class_name text, class_sort_order integer, tattoo text, placement text, award text, judged_by_show_judge_id uuid, judge_name text, is_shown boolean, is_disqualified boolean)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
AS $function$
  with filtered_sections as (
    select
      s.id,
      s.kind,
      s.letter
    from public.show_sections s
    where s.show_id = p_show_id
      and upper(coalesce(s.kind::text, '')) = upper(coalesce(p_scope, ''))
      and (
        upper(coalesce(p_show_letter, '')) = 'ALL'
        or upper(coalesce(s.letter::text, '')) = upper(coalesce(p_show_letter, ''))
      )
      and s.is_enabled = true
  )
  select
    rer.entry_id,
    p_show_id as show_id,
    rer.section_id,
    concat(fs.kind::text, ' ', fs.letter::text) as section_label,
    fs.kind::text as section_kind,
    fs.letter::text as section_letter,
    rer.exhibitor_id,
    rer.exhibitor_label,
    rer.breed_name,
    rer.variety_name,
    rer.group_name,
    rer.sex,
    rer.class_name,
    rer.class_sort_order,
    rer.tattoo,
    rer.placement,
    coalesce(r.award, '') as award,
    rer.judged_by_show_judge_id,
    coalesce(
      j_direct.display_name,
      j_direct.name,
      j_via_show.display_name,
      j_via_show.name,
      ''
    ) as judge_name,
    rer.is_shown,
    rer.is_disqualified
  from filtered_sections fs
  cross join lateral public.report_results_entry_rows(p_show_id, fs.id, p_show_letter) rer
  left join public.results r
    on r.entry_id = rer.entry_id
   and r.show_id = p_show_id
  left join public.judges j_direct
    on j_direct.id = rer.judged_by_show_judge_id
  left join public.show_judges sj
    on sj.show_id = p_show_id
   and sj.judge_id = rer.judged_by_show_judge_id
  left join public.judges j_via_show
    on j_via_show.id = sj.judge_id
  where lower(trim(coalesce(rer.breed_name, ''))) = lower(trim(coalesce(p_breed_name, '')))
  order by
    fs.letter,
    lower(coalesce(rer.variety_name, '')),
    lower(coalesce(rer.group_name, '')),
    rer.class_sort_order,
    lower(coalesce(rer.sex, '')),
    lower(coalesce(rer.tattoo, ''));
$function$
